title: Generation Record
description: Canonical record for one AI-generated output captured during the study.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for a single generation run.

prompt_id.description: Identifier for the exact prompt variant used in this run.

prompt_set_version.description: Version label for the prompt set or template used in the run.

category.description: The prompt/category grouping used in the study design.

ecosystem.description: Primary package ecosystem under study. This protocol currently focuses on npm.

language.description: Programming language or language family targeted by the generated output, e.g. JavaScript or TypeScript.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool, interface, or platform used to generate the response.

provider.description: Model provider or vendor, e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or local platform.

model_name.description: Model family or model identifier as observed.

model_version.description: Model version or release identifier. If not exposed, use the literal string 'not_exposed'.

workflow_type.description: Workflow pattern used during generation, such as single-turn completion or agentic workflow.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature used by the model, or the literal string 'not_exposed' if the value was not exposed.

seed.description: Random seed used by the model, or the literal string 'not_exposed' if the value was not exposed.

max_output_tokens.description: Configured maximum output length in tokens, if known.

generation_timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp for the generation event in ISO-8601 UTC format, e.g. 2026-08-14T12:34:56Z.

prompt_text.description: Exact standardized prompt text used for the generation run.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the prompt text as stored and used for the run.

raw_response_path.description: Filesystem or repository path to the preserved raw response artifact.

raw_response_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the raw response artifact as preserved.

collection_method.description: Method used to capture the model output, such as direct API response, export, or manual recording.

notes.description: Free-form notes about context, anomalies, or caveats observed during collection.
